ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-to-mid range; dominant low-intensity (black) pixels across ~70% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in a large contiguous patch on the right lobe and scattered speckling on the left.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region located in the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe; diffuse, low-density white speckling (mottling) distributed across the mid-to-lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; vertex depth is approximately 15% of total lobe height with an estimated internal angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; distinct sawtooth-like peaks visible along the medial trailing edge of both lobes; several deep indentations present on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to pointed, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast tan/white clusters present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting a rough, raised pixel texture compared to the smooth fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical high-intensity linear mark on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable tissue irregularity and calcified clusters at the distal tips; irregular jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting prior mechanical stress or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric pigmentation where the right lobe contains a large white field while the left lobe remains predominantly dark.
